Delete VPN Credential
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/vpnCredentials/:vpnId

Deletes the VPN credentials for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
vpnId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the VPN credential.

Responses
​
204

Successful Operation. No Content Returned.
